plugin.name: API Bridge
plugin.description: Enables external applications to control LTTH through HTTP and WebSocket APIs.

contract.title: API Bridge contract
contract.lede: Inspect these local endpoints before integrating a client. This page never sends an action request.

endpoints.info: Identify the running LTTH and API Bridge versions.
endpoints.actions: List action IDs and their declared parameters. Reading this endpoint has no side effect.
endpoints.events: Review the most recent event record; a new temporary profile starts with an empty list.
endpoints.request: Execution belongs in a separately tested client. Verify the required body without sending it here.

safety.title: Safe integration boundary
safety.body: Use GET endpoints first. Keep credentials and production action IDs out of screenshots and test profiles; POST execution is intentionally not available on this page.
